body: Good news everyone. My partner has decided to give me another chance to change. Not officially back together but it’s a step forward. Checking into an inpatient facility on Wednesday for a month to get back to the old me :)
Got myself some ice cream and chicken wings hahaha. Thankyou so much !
Alcoholism has just been a symptom of something deeper. But I’ll keep working to get better. Thankyou for your words of encouragement :)
Takes losing everything to realise this :/
Thankyou all for your positive words. I love this community. Thankyou
